description.value: Bulkley Valley Wholesale is a long-established grocery and food service wholesaler that has operated out of Smithers since 1959, now part of the Pattison Food Group. Originally wholesale-only, the store opened to retail customers in 2000, giving the general public access to its broad selection of grocery and food service products at competitive prices. Situated on Highway 16, it is a practical resupply stop for cyclists touring northwest BC's main corridor.
